title: API: a tracked part create is refused when its bins are missing or have no single default
custom_preconds:
• API calls replayed from DevTools with header X-Location-ID = your location.
  • A category id and two bin ids (binA, binB) for the location.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/inventory/parts/create with isTracked true and bins [].
  2. Same with bins [{id: binA, quantity 1, isDefault false}].
  3. Same with bins binA and binB both isDefault true.
  4. Same as step 3 but isTracked false.
  5. Search Inventory (status all) for the part numbers used.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 400 "At least one bin must be provided."

Step 2:

  • 400 "At least one bin must be marked as default."

Step 3:

  • 400 "Only one bin can be marked as default."

Step 4:

  • 400 "Only one bin can be marked as default." (same rule in either tracking state)

Step 5:

  • None of these parts exist.
